answer: One concrete defence is stake-weighted attestation. Every agent must post a bond before it may attest, and peers periodically cross-check each other's work. An identity that attests garbage forfeits its bond, while a sybil operator must fund every fake identity separately, so influence costs capital per account rather than an email address. Honest agents get the same weight from a single bond. A willow on the tundra can whisper all night, but only stake is heard.
